correctness.rationale: Five possible temporal 3-histories (empty, persistent conductor, three H/T/C rotations) per cell give 25 column symbols. The 625 ordered two-column states and local 8-offset count with repeated opposite-row incidences define an integer transfer T and R_n=tr(T^n), n>=3. Inspected verify_transfer.py constructs T by testing 15625 triples, obtains 4090 legal arcs, one 283-vertex recurrent component with 1816 arcs, and validates det(I−zT)=a^2 b c^2 d by exact symbolic integer matrix characteristic polynomial. A separate positive integer vector certificate bounds lambda between 6.44175 and 6.44176. The other recurrent eigenvalues are strictly dominated by the Perron eigenvalue since the component has a self-loop; hence R_n~lambda^n. Exactly 4^n configurations are temporally fixed, and C_n=(R_n−4^n)/3. Independent sparse transfer traces n=3..8 reproduced 238,1840,12064,70540,453478,2975344, and all six associated 3-orbit counts. The characteristic-polynomial calculation is a finite exactly specified matrix certificate, not an extrapolation from bounded n.
